params.name: options
params.type: { baseUrl?: string; apiKey?: string; accountKey?: string; fetchImpl?: FetchLike; dumpsBaseUrl?: string; archiveBaseUrl?: string; archiveOpsUrl?: string; origin?: "cli" | "mcp" | "session"; verify?: boolean | { publicKey: string; }; verifyDumpsManifest?: boolean; requestTimeoutMs?: number; etagCache?: false | EtagCache }

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.description: Base URL of the instance API (trailing slashes are stripped).

fields.name: apiKey
fields.description:
Bearer token for authenticated requests. Defaults to
`SECONDLAYER_API_KEY` on `api.secondlayer.tools`, `INSTANCE_TOKEN`
elsewhere.

fields.name: accountKey
fields.description:
Hosted account key (`sk-sl_*`). Env `SECONDLAYER_API_KEY`. Used by
`sl.archive` quote/fetch/credits; reaches `/v1` and `/api` only through
`apiKey` when the base URL is the hosted API.

fields.name: fetchImpl
fields.description: Fetch implementation. Tests and edge runtimes can provide their own.

fields.name: dumpsBaseUrl
fields.description:
Public base URL for Streams bulk parquet dumps (the cold backfill plane).
Required for `streams.dumps.*`; without it the dumps client falls back to
its built-in default.

fields.name: archiveBaseUrl
fields.description:
Public base URL for the signed canonical archive tree. Defaults to
`https://archive.secondlayer.tools`. Reaches `sl.archive`.

fields.name: archiveOpsUrl
fields.description:
Credits and fetch-gate API. Defaults to `https://api.secondlayer.tools`,
not `baseUrl`. Reaches `sl.archive` quote/fetch/credits.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Deploy origin label sent as `x-sl-origin` (telemetry). Defaults to `cli`.

fields.name: verify
fields.description:
Check the ed25519 signature on every Streams read. Omit for lenient
(verify when signed, pass through unsigned self-host responses), `true`
or `{ publicKey }` for strict, `false` for off. Reaches `sl.streams`.

fields.name: verifyDumpsManifest
fields.description:
Check the dumps manifest signature before trusting any file hash
(default on). Reaches `sl.streams.dumps`.

fields.name: requestTimeoutMs
fields.description:
How long one request may take, headers and body, before it fails with a
retryable `ApiError` (default 30 000 ms). A hung socket then trips the
retry policy instead of stalling a walk or consume loop forever. `0`
disables the timeout.

fields.name: etagCache
fields.description:
Where GET responses carrying an `ETag` are kept, so a repeat read sends
`If-None-Match` and a finalized page comes back as a free `304`.
Defaults to an in-memory store of the last 64 pages. Pass your own to
keep it across processes (a file, a KV), or `false` to turn it off.

methods.summary: Run up to 10 public reads in one round trip (`POST /v1/batch`).
methods.description:
Run up to 10 public reads in one round trip (`POST /v1/batch`).

Each item is authorized on its own; the client's bearer token applies to
every item. Results come back in order as `{ path, status, body }`. Only
paths under `/v1/index/`, `/v1/subgraphs`, `/v1/streams/`, and
`/v1/contracts` are allowed; anything else is a per-item 400.

params.name: requests
params.type: { path: string; params?: Record<string, string | number | boolean> }[]

returns.type: Promise<{ results: { path: string | null; status: number; body: unknown }[] }>

methods.summary: Get a one-call snapshot of your account and instance.
methods.description:
Get a one-call snapshot of your account and instance.

Returns a [`ContextSnapshot`](/docs/sdk-reference/client#t-ContextSnapshot): the same orientation an MCP agent reads
from `secondlayer://context`, available to any SDK or CLI consumer. Reads
run concurrently; a failed read lands as `{ value: null, error }` on its
field rather than rejecting the whole snapshot.

types.name: ContextField
types.summary: One snapshot field: the value, or `null` plus the error that produced it.

types.name: ContextFieldError
types.summary: Why one snapshot field could not be read.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
Stable code from the API envelope (`UNAUTHORIZED`, `INDEX_NOT_READY`)
or the SDK (`REQUEST_TIMEOUT`); absent for a bare transport failure.

fields.name: status
fields.description: HTTP status; `0` when the API could not be reached.

fields.name: retryable
fields.description: Whether the same read can succeed on a retry (429, 5xx, network).

types.name: ContextSnapshot
types.summary: A point-in-time orientation snapshot: live tips and what this instance holds.

fields.name: webhooks
fields.type: ContextField<{ count: number; byStatus: Record<string, number> }>

types.name: EtagEntry
types.summary: One cached GET response: its validator and the body it validated.

types.name: FetchLike
types.definition: (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>

fields.name: finalized_height
fields.description:
Highest height treated as immutable (past the burn-confirmation
finality boundary). Rows at or below it never reorg — `finalizedOnly`
consumers gate on this, since Index rows carry no per-event flag.

types.name: InstanceDiagnosis
types.summary: An instance's state, the API verdict, and the issues found.

fields.name: overall
fields.description: The API's own top-level verdict, passed through unmodified.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What is wrong, in one line.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Why — assembled only from what the payload actually reports.

fields.name: nextSteps
fields.description: What to run next, most useful first.

types.name: StreamsTip
types.summary: The chain tip: latest block, Bitcoin anchor, and finality boundary.

fields.name: finalized_height
fields.description:
Highest Stacks block past the burn-confirmation finality boundary.
Optional for back-compat; the API always sets it.

fields.name: oldest_seekable_height
fields.description:
Oldest height still seekable on the live API for the caller's tier
(`tip - retention`). `null` = unlimited retention. Older reads must use the
cold dumps lane. Optional for back-compat.

fields.name: oldest_cursor
fields.description: Oldest seekable cursor (`<oldest_seekable_height>:0`); `null` = unlimited.

types.name: SubgraphSummary
types.summary: A subgraph's name, status, and indexing progress.

fields.name: integrity
fields.description: history_filling = expected gaps while a tip-first backfill op runs.

fields.name: lastError
fields.description: Most recent indexing error reason + when it occurred, if any.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last row mutation timestamp; powers per-card freshness.
